system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes, lean and sharp-eyed, seated in a wicker chair drawn into a corner of the room","action":"Holmes sits silent, eyes travelling slowly over the ceiling, panelling and bed, while he gestures toward the thick bell-rope hanging beside the bed, its tassel resting on the pillow","setting":"Small whitewashed bedroom in an old English country house with low ceiling, gaping fireplace, brown worm-eaten oak panelling, square Wilton carpet, narrow white-counterpaned bed, brown chest of drawers, dressing-table by the window","secondaryElements":"Dr. Watson standing nearby in tweeds and frock-coat, Helen Stoner in plain country-house dress near the doorway, the bell-rope and its tassel on the pillow as focal detail, a small side door to the corridor","mood":"Quiet, watchful, gothic restraint with dry suspense and gaslit intimacy","timeOfDay":"Daytime, overcast","composition":"Interior view from the doorway angle, Holmes in the lower corner with the bell-rope and bed in the middle ground, soft dim daylight from the window falling across the carpet"}
